name: anime-4k-hdr
description: Reference pipeline: restore -> 2x -> 2x -> sharpen -> 4K -> semantic HDR -> JPEG XR. Every line is independently insertable/removable.

stages.note: path comes from `imgen run -i FILE` unless params.path is set
needs ffmpeg; without it use denoise.nlmeans or denoise.bilateral (pure numpy)
kill banding BEFORE upscaling, while it is still cheap to fix

stages.label: 2x-pass-2
stages.note: two 2x passes instead of one 4x: the second pass sees the first pass's output
cap at 4K: the Windows HDR wallpaper path and the WIC encoder are 4K-friendly
LumiPic / FLUX-class LoRA; result cached as .npy so hdr.map can be re-tuned for free
measured on this project's input: 874 -> 647 nit peak and >500nit 0.036% -> 0.002%; see docs/HDR-NOTES.md
